alerts.name: error-rate
alerts.title: error rate
alerts.query:
SELECT table_name, round(error_rate, 2) AS error_rate, threshold,
  CASE WHEN error_rate > threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exceeded
FROM (
  SELECT 'continuation_transformation' AS table_name, 1.0 AS threshold,
    try_divide(100 * count_if(coalesce(size(`_errors`), 0) > 0), count(*)) AS error_rate
  FROM `${environment}`.`donnees_qc_req`.`continuation_transformation`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'domaine_valeur' AS table_name, 1.0 AS threshold,
    try_divide(100 * count_if(coalesce(size(`_errors`), 0) > 0), count(*)) AS error_rate
  FROM `${environment}`.`donnees_qc_req`.`domaine_valeur`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'entreprise' AS table_name, 1.0 AS threshold,
    try_divide(100 * count_if(coalesce(size(`_errors`), 0) > 0), count(*)) AS error_rate
  FROM `${environment}`.`donnees_qc_req`.`entreprise`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'etablissement' AS table_name, 1.0 AS threshold,
    try_divide(100 * count_if(coalesce(size(`_errors`), 0) > 0), count(*)) AS error_rate
  FROM `${environment}`.`donnees_qc_req`.`etablissement`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'fusion_scission' AS table_name, 1.0 AS threshold,
    try_divide(100 * count_if(coalesce(size(`_errors`), 0) > 0), count(*)) AS error_rate
  FROM `${environment}`.`donnees_qc_req`.`fusion_scission`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'nom_entreprise' AS table_name, 1.0 AS threshold,
    try_divide(100 * count_if(coalesce(size(`_errors`), 0) > 0), count(*)) AS error_rate
  FROM `${environment}`.`donnees_qc_req`.`nom_entreprise`
) AS rates
ORDER BY table_name

alerts.name: latency
alerts.title: latency
alerts.query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'continuation_transformation' AS table_name, '18 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '18' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_req' AND table_name = 'continuation_transformation') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'domaine_valeur' AS table_name, '18 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '18' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_req' AND table_name = 'domaine_valeur') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'entreprise' AS table_name, '18 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '18' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_req' AND table_name = 'entreprise') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'etablissement' AS table_name, '18 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '18' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_req' AND table_name = 'etablissement') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'fusion_scission' AS table_name, '18 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '18' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_req' AND table_name = 'fusion_scission') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'nom_entreprise' AS table_name, '18 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '18' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_req' AND table_name = 'nom_entreprise') AS t
) AS freshness
ORDER BY table_name
